source_differential.unit_detection: x^2 d5(B)=2k^2U=x^2(kQ), a nonzero order-two class; d5 squared excludes the independent kP direction.
source_differential.even_D_translation: d5(D^2)=2kD^2h2 is nonzero, but its product with B is zero because 2B=0. This gives d5(B)=kQ without declaring D^2 a 5-cycle.

finite_product_scope: These are numerator products under the common Thom identification. The representation regrading and D^2 factor are supplied by Phi^-1 in transport, not by an equality of the unregraded RO degrees.

transport.completion_scope: The same Thom unit reduces to the same nonzero F4 scalar on these two finite directions. The complete E2 cell at (14,2) also contains a separate bo/series direction; it is not asserted to be one-dimensional.

deduction: Naturality gives d5(AD^2)=zeta TkD^2 after cancellation of the common nonzero scalar.
Thus c+1=zeta and c=zeta^2 in the specified basis.
Cross-check: d5(BD)=kD(P+Q), F(BD)=alpha zeta AD^3, and F(kD(P+Q))=alpha zeta(1+zeta)TkD^3=alpha TkD^3. Dividing the common alpha zeta gives d5(AD^3)=zeta^2 TkD^3.
period_scope: The 16-stem A differential pattern follows from 2A=0 and the Leibniz rule. Only D^8 is a permanent invertible horizontal period. g is inverted solely in the Tate comparison.

historical_comparison.disposition: Preserve the printed rows as historical provenance. Their scalar order differs from this independently checked action/basis convention; do not silently rewrite the table.

source_refs: Beaudry Appendix A, Lemma A.1 and Theorem A.14: omega(k)=k

root_proof_requirements: A unique coefficient-proof proposition with accepted status and, when present, accepted admission_status.
A nonempty explicit premise list and matching conclusion.parameter_id; coefficient_value is a non-boolean F4 unit.
Every recursively referenced differential proof has one matching current row, accepted status, present nonarchived stored endpoints and an accepted nonarchived matrix when applicable.
The coefficient-proof mode is strict without changing the legacy cycle-proof convention.
registry_requirements: All declarations of mixed_d5_A, including same-name duplicate proposition records, must have the same qualified binding.
A failed binding clears the whole resolved record and cannot fall back to settings, stale raw values or candidate assignments.
Keep the resolved raw unit separate from each consumer's affine offset, inverse denominator and Frobenius transformation.
The cache includes recursive proof scopes, differential endpoints/status/page, endpoint existence/archive state and matrix status.
integration_requirements.implementation: coefficient_proofs.ensure_coefficient_proofs registers once; fate.resolve_raw_coefficient_parameter strictly checks the current proof and its qualified differential premises. The JSON alone never assigns settings or guarantees admission.
